message.content:
A yellow magazine cover for "TEMPO" dated "EDISI 25 FEBRUARI-3 MARET 2013" features a man in the foreground. The man has short, dark hair and wears metal-rimmed eyeglasses. He is shown from the chest up, wearing a collared, greyish-green shirt. He holds a rectangular blue object, resembling a bank book with the text "bank bjb" printed upside down on a white stripe, in his right hand. His hand is raised, and his palm faces toward the left. His mouth is slightly open. On his left wrist is a silver-colored watch with a round face.

A stream of black digits, including 0s, 1s, 2s, 5s, 6s, 8s, and 9s, emerges from the top of the blue book and floats upward, curling towards the right. The large white title "TEMPO" is centered at the top. Bold black and red text on the left reads "RUNYAM AHER BANK DIBOBOL". Smaller text at the top reads "GONJANG-GANJING SETELAH ANAS TERSANGKA" and "DI BALIK LAYAR MUNDURNYA PAUS". A barcode, price "RP 29.700", and publishing details are located in the bottom left corner.
